name: Template Output
description: The `template` output component can be used to create templated binary and float outputs in ESPHome.

config_entries.label: Type
config_entries.description: The type of output. One of binary and float.

config_entries.label: Inverted
config_entries.description: If the output should be treated as inverted. Defaults to `false`.

config_entries.label: Power Supply
config_entries.description: The [power supply](https://esphome.io/components/power_supply/) to connect to this output. When the output is enabled, the power supply will automatically be switched on too.

config_entries.label: Write Action
config_entries.description: An automation to perform when the state of the output is updated.

config_entries.label: ID
config_entries.description: The id to use for this output component.

config_entries.label: Max Power
config_entries.description: Sets the maximum output value of this output platform. Must be in range from min_power to 1. Defaults to `1`.

config_entries.label: Min Power
config_entries.description: Sets the minimum output value of this output platform. Must be in range from 0 to max_power. Defaults to `0`. If zero_means_zero is `false` this will be output value when the entity is turned off.

config_entries.label: Zero Means Zero
config_entries.description: Sets the output to use actual 0 instead of `min_power`. Defaults to `false`.
